entities.name: Traffic flow aggregate description
entities.description: Specifies the aggregate of one or more packet filters and their related parameters and operations. Determines traffic mapping to EPS bearer contexts for downlink, uplink, or both directions.

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE requests allocation of bearer resources, associated with a specific PTI.

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE requests modification of existing bearer resources, associated with a specific PTI.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: Identifies a particular UE requested bearer resource procedure transaction.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request bearer resource allocation.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request bearer resource modification.

entities.name: Packet filter identifier
entities.description: Identifies a packet filter within a traffic flow aggregate description. Must be unique across all packet filters for an EPS bearer context.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer context to which packet filters belong.

entities.name: Newly created packet filters
entities.description: Condition where packet filters are newly created, requiring packet filter identifiers to be set to 0.

entities.name: Existing packet filters
entities.description: Condition where packet filters already exist, requiring packet filter identifiers to be set from existing assigned values.

entities.name: Unique packet filter identifiers
entities.description: Property requiring packet filter identifiers to be unique across all packet filters for an EPS bearer context.

relations.description: Traffic flow aggregate description contains packet filter identifiers.
UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure is associated with a PTI.
UE requested bearer resource modification procedure is associated with a PTI.
BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message contains the Traffic flow aggregate description IE.
BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message contains the Traffic flow aggregate description IE.
Packet filter identifier value is set to 0 when packet filters are newly created.
Packet filter identifier value is set from existing assigned values when packet filters already exist.
Packet filter identifiers must be unique across all packet filters for the EPS bearer context.
Traffic flow aggregate description is associated with an EPS bearer context identified by EPS bearer identity.
